terms.definition: First major realm of cultivation.
Second major realm in which the cultivator's foundation is rebuilt.
Realm in which cultivation condenses into a golden core in the dantian.
Realm in which the golden core births a nascent soul that can survive the body's death.
Realm in which the nascent soul transforms and merges with spirit.
High realm in which the self is refined toward harmony with the void.
High realm uniting body and soul into one.
Penultimate realm of most cultivation systems.
Realm-crossing trial in which the cultivator must survive heavenly tribulation to ascend.
One who cultivates toward immortality.
A cultivator's accumulated power and progress.
Innate aptitude that determines one's ability to cultivate.
Ambient energy of heaven and earth drawn in during cultivation.
Crystallized spiritual energy used as currency and cultivation aid.
A cultivator's spiritual perception, extending beyond the five senses.
Inner corruption that tempts a cultivator's mind during cultivation.
Heaven-sent disaster that tests cultivators at major breakthroughs.
Dangerous condition in which cultivation goes awry and the mind is corrupted.
Retreating into isolation to cultivate undisturbed.
Emerging from closed-door cultivation.
Demonic art of seizing another's body to replace one's own.
The immaterial essence of a being.
Beast that has awakened spiritual intelligence by absorbing spiritual energy.
Cultivator who practices demonic or unorthodox arts.
Cultivator unaffiliated with any sect.
One who has transcended mortality through cultivation.
Formal organization that teaches cultivation arts.
Senior member who helps govern a sect.
The head of a sect.
Disciple personally taught a sect's true teachings.
Full disciple of a sect's inner court.
Probationary disciple of a sect's outer court.
Private cultivated dwelling, often inside a mountain cave.
Hidden pocket world containing opportunities and dangers.
Trading town where cultivators buy and sell.
Refined spiritual implement a cultivator can wield in battle.
Pouch whose inner space is far larger than its exterior.
Sword its owner controls remotely to fly and fight from afar.
Refined medicine that boosts cultivation or heals.
Furnace used to refine pills.
Array that instantly transports those within it to a linked array.
Arrayed patterns that harness energy to protect, trap, or empower.
A cultivator's partner on the path, akin to a spouse.
